ordinary_tracking: B0 and B1-score frozen; no GT after initialization; no retuning
data: existing Wave2 pilot plus separately predeclared additional official segments; shared video lineages not independent
primary_coordinates: native annotation numeric initialization and metrics unchanged
support_coordinates: assumed annotation origin 1, always repeat origin 0; no best-origin selection
uncertainty: sequence-level cluster bootstrap or descriptive per-sequence rates; no frame-iid intervals or causal tests
quality_limitations: exploratory image statistics, not validated optical information, blur, occlusion or perception quality; bbox support is not true visible object area

oracle.baseline_model: released original B0 model and checkpoint, eval mode, no updates; B1 response interpretation supplemental on same response
oracle.sample_policy: deterministic evenly spaced valid tracking frames within each sequence and observed full/partial/outside containment group; maximum 4 per group; same selected frames for both origin assumptions
oracle.enlarged_side: smallest bounded integer side that guarantees geometric target containment at the observed center; at most 4096 source pixels, budget failures recorded
oracle.observed_probe_reproduction: compare raw class probabilities, BCE logits and decoded candidate boxes to immutable ordinary-run grids before accepting an intervention
oracle.limitations: current GT centers reveal location; response changes include context/window/scale priors and not only representation. Translation cannot guarantee containment if target exceeds source side; off-image target pixels cannot be recovered. Probe IoUs are never reported as tracking AUC.

hypotheses.H1: crop availability limitation within selected panel
hypotheses.H2: contained localization/discrimination limitation, separating scoring/prior from candidate availability when possible
hypotheses.H3: source information association beyond footprint and motion among comparable contained examples; causal attribution not established
